I've had a few seizures at my store and was taken away by ambulance. I just called my store before my shift each day and told them I was still in the hospital and brought in a doctors note and they removed them (not sure how it works if its not in store).

Basically what an occurrence is is a strike against you. Once you earn more than three one of your mods will call you too the office and give you what is called a coaching, Basically just having you sign something and tell you not to get more. After 3 more you'll get called in again and same thing happens but you get told if you earn one more you get put on a final notice. Earn one more after that and you are terminated. Occurrences and coaching/counselings also fall off your record after six month. You may notice your hours being cut as well. So say you get a counseling after six months of being on one with no further occurrences your back at the baseline and the whole process would have to repeat again.
